title: Constructing $C^1$ limit surfaces from unstructured splines via averaging and refinement
summary: In this paper we present a construction for unstructured splines over quadrilateral meshes by iterative averaging and refinement. We represent the spline as a multi-patch B-spline, where the degrees of freedom are those B-spline coefficients on the quadrilateral patches that are not associated with interior edges and vertices of the mesh, i.e., their corresponding Greville points lie inside the patches.
